long_biography.plain_text:
Maher Holding gave Mahmut Erdemoğlu a platform for moving into industries outside the carpet businesses he had managed for his family. He founded the group in 2015, then entered insurance with Quick Sigorta two years later; the acquisition of what became Corpus Sigorta followed.

Insurance remains the centre of Erdemoğlu's group, alongside non-bank finance, property and technology. Surety insurance opened a non-bank route for corporate guarantees, while the group added financing, payments and property businesses. He has described a strategy of reinvesting insurance-generated funds across assets rather than depending on interest income alone. Erdemoğlu remains chairman of the holding and its principal insurance, finance and property companies.
